verdicts.reason: A keeps DEAN COOPER large and dominant, but the geometric pattern is cropped to a narrow strip behind the name. The white frame and both pink dots sit in an empty box on the right that serves no purpose. THE MINIMALIST pill is pushed to the far left, apart from the rest, and the date line runs into the pattern's edge. B is worse. The name is shrunk and placed above 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS', which reverses the reading order, and THE MINIMALIST is reduced to an unreadable tag. The date and studio text sit on the busy pattern and the white box edges, and the dots are stranded at the far canvas edges.
